title: Privacy-Enhanced Zero-Order Federated Learning via xMK-CKKS over Wireless Channels
abstract: arXiv:2605.30123v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Homomorphic encryption (HE) enables privacy-preserving aggregation in federated learning (FL) by allowing the server to operate on encrypted data without decryption. Existing HE-over-the-air (OTA) methods mainly rely on single-key HE schemes and require channel estimation or pre-equalization to compensate for wireless fading. However, single-key HE remains vulnerable to honest-but-curious (HBC) clients holding the shared secret key, while multi-key HE provides stronger client-level security by assigning each device its own secret key. We propose a four-phase protocol that enables the aggregation of xMK-CKKS over a shared wireless channel without channel estimation. The protocol retransmits partial public keys and ciphertexts through the same channel realization, so that the dominant large-modulus encryption terms cancel algebraically during decryption. translated_title: 基于xMK-CKKS的无线信道隐私增强零阶联邦学习
translated_abstract: 同态加密（HE）通过允许服务器在不解密的情况下对加密数据进行操作，从而实现联邦学习（FL）中的隐私保护聚合。现有的无线空口（OTA）同态加密方法主要依赖单密钥同态加密方案，并需要信道估计或预均衡来补偿无线衰落。然而，单密钥同态加密对于持有共享密钥的诚实但好奇（HBC）客户端仍然存在安全漏洞，而多密钥同态加密通过为每个设备分配各自的密钥，提供了更强的客户端级安全性。我们提出了一种四阶段协议，能够在无需信道估计的情况下，通过共享无线信道实现xMK-CKKS的聚合。该协议通过相同的信道实现重传部分公钥和密文，使得主导的大模数加密项在解密过程中被代数抵消。我们将该协议与零阶联邦学习相结合，应用于慢变化的视距（LoS）主导的无线环境。
tldr: 该论文提出一种四阶段协议，利用多密钥xMK-CKKS同态加密在共享无线信道上实现无需信道估计的隐私保护联邦学习聚合，通过相同信道实现重传公钥与密文，使大模数加密项在解密时被代数抵消，同时抵御诚实但好奇客户端的攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a four-phase protocol that enables channel-estimation-free aggregation of multi-key xMK-CKKS encrypted federated learning over shared wireless channels, where retransmitting public keys and ciphertexts through the same channel realization causes dominant large-modulus encryption terms to cancel algebraically during decryption, providing stronger client-level security against honest-but-curious clients.
